title: Its_Padar's Emeralds
body:
This mod adds emerald armour and tools to Minecraft.

<details>
<summary>What does this mod add?</summary>

Currently all equipment is 1.5x better than iron. (This will be changed in the next update)

Emerald helmet

Emerald chestplate

Emerald leggings

Emerald boots

Emerald sword

Emerald pickaxe

Emerald axe

Emerald hoe

Emerald shovel


</details>

Feel free to use this mod in modpacks, however do not redistribute it, please just have it downloaded from Modrinth.
